facts.fact: 女主以「我因母亲之死来到人间」回怼派她侦察的将军——出生即丧母；她军阶 Commander Theron，胯下战马 Jaco
facts.anchor: I entered this world by way of my mother’s death. You will find I am no stranger to the dead

facts.fact: Guard Fragon 与她已驻营三月、友情渐深；他的 Deep Lung（深肺）经她验证确为血赋而非话痨属性
facts.anchor: we worked on his Deep Lung enough to determine it is truly a blood gift

facts.fact: 两人爬上脊线侦察：约二十名装束一致的 Dranderon 士兵在 Triovalice 河故道扎营——敌军确在本侧立足
facts.anchor: There are about twenty men, unquestionably soldiers by their matching attire

facts.fact: 遭落单 Dranderon 袭击：她挣脱后与其单挑，对方从树后偷看过他们、出言挑逗「女人为何在森林里」——她以断腿、砍颈反杀，留话「该把头盔戴好」
facts.anchor: What’s a woman like you doing in the forest playing with the Arkendrathi?

facts.fact: 混战中她弃剑拔靴匕，跨五马身掷出、穿颅击毙欲向 Garwolin 将军投红石的敌人——将军非但不惊还点头致谢
facts.anchor: my sword reflexively drops straight into the snow, freeing my right hand so I can grab my boot dagger

facts.fact: 缴获的火之 Power Stone（Hayden 之力，可控爆炸）在她掌中脉动后认她为主；新晋 Guard Blight 盼着看她引爆
facts.anchor: pulses in my hand before settling—accepting me as its new owner

facts.fact: 回营遇 Captain Icarus：首都来令，全军召回参加 Brinden Trials（布林登试炼）——召回令比战斗更让她恼火
facts.anchor: A letter came from the capital. We are to return.

facts.fact: Missive Master Aldric 擅自把她登记为明日启程，她怒抓胸前护符斥其越权；Garwolin 将军表态：Nash 将军不会准她缺席试炼
facts.anchor: I’ve already logged you as leaving tomorrow.

facts.fact: Garwolin 揭底：三个月来一直在暗中评估她（因 Nash 是她叔叔不能自评），报告一周前已交
facts.anchor: These last three months, you have been evaluated by me

facts.fact: 她其实已通过第一场 Brinden Trial——考题就是「你一个人打不完这场战争」，她的回答「也许不能，但我会试试」正是答案
facts.anchor: You have completed and passed your first trial.

facts.fact: 评语：热情、创造力、忠于王国与部下、剿灭 Dranderon 不倦、带兵训练出色、战术准备充分；「你的权威是挣来的，不是继承的」；「你不是淑女」她回「我两者都是」
facts.anchor: Your authority is earned, not inherited.
